T: Keep the curtains drawn. Keep the kettle on.
D: A mother and her two light-sensitive children live in a dark house on Jersey after the war.
P: Serve the tea when Mrs Mills brings in the tray.
S: the housekeeper who knows more than she lets on

Dough of flour, butter, sugar and eggs rested an hour, rolled, cut into strips, slit and twisted, fried at 175C until golden, dusted with sugar. Rub 50g butter into 250g flour, add 50g sugar and 2 eggs and knead. Rest an hour, roll out, cut strips, slit and twist through. Fry at 175C until golden and dust with sugar and nutmeg.
Mrs Mills's egg and cress tea sandwiches

Crustless white sandwiches of creamy curried egg and cress, plus cucumber with salted butter and white pepper, cut into fingers and stacked on the tray. Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water, peel and mash with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, half a teaspoon of curry powder, salt and pepper. Butter 12 slices of soft white bread. Spread the egg on 4 slices, scatter a punnet of cress and top with 4 more. Slice 1 continental cucumber paper thin, salt lightly and pat dry, then layer on the last 4 slices with white pepper and close. Cut off the crusts and slice into fingers.
Crab meat folded with mayo, lemon, chives and a pinch of cayenne, piled on buttered toast.
M: Mr Tuttle's garden potatoes and fish
the gardener raking leaves over something

Small new potatoes boiled with mint and tossed in salted butter, with pan-fried white fish, capers and brown butter. Boil 800g new potatoes with mint and toss in salted butter. Pan-fry 4 white fish fillets until golden. Brown 60g butter, add 1 tbsp capers and lemon juice, and spoon over the fish.

Lamb mince slow-cooked with onion, carrot, peas, rosemary and a good splash of Worcestershire, under a crisp buttery mash crust baked golden. Brown 800g lamb mince in a hot pan, then add 1 diced onion and 2 diced carrots and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp plain flour, 1 tbsp Worcestershire, chopped rosemary and 400ml beef stock and simmer for 30 minutes until thick, adding 150g frozen peas at the end. Boil 1.2kg peeled potatoes, mash with 80g butter and 100ml hot milk. Spread the lamb in a baking dish, top with mash, rough it up with a fork and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.
W: lock one door before you open the next

Short grain rice baked slowly at 150C for 2 hours in full cream milk, cream, sugar and a vanilla bean, nutmeg grated on top, served by candlelight. Put 100g short grain rice, 800ml milk, 200ml cream, 70g sugar and a split vanilla bean in a dish. Bake at 150C for 2 hours, stirring twice. Grate nutmeg on top. Serve warm, curtains drawn.
K: Island apple cider toddy from the teapot
always a pot on the tray, though this one isn't tea

Jersey-style dry apple cider warmed with honey, lemon, cinnamon and cloves, a splash of brandy stirred in, poured into teacups from a warmed pot. Pour 1.2 litres dry apple cider into a saucepan with 3 tbsp honey, the peeled zest of a lemon, 1 cinnamon stick and 4 cloves. Warm gently for 10 minutes without boiling. Take off the heat, stir in 120ml brandy and the juice of half a lemon. Warm a teapot with hot water, tip it out, strain the cider into the pot and pour into teacups at the table.
